name: What is the typical timeline for a tiny home project from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for a tiny home project from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a tiny home project can vary significantly based on factors like design complexity, permitting processes, and whether the home is built on a foundation or wheels. Generally, a custom tiny home project, from initial consultation and design to final construction and move-in, can take anywhere from 4 to 12 months. This includes time for site preparation, obtaining necessary permits, and the actual construction phase. We work with clients to establish a realistic schedule early in the planning stages.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical tiny home project, from design to completion, can take 4 to 12 months, depending on complexity and permitting.
